programmes.d: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.

The 2025 European Motocross Championship is the 37th European Motocross Championship season since it was revived in 1988. It includes 16 events and 6 different classes. It will start in Spain on 16 March and will end in Turkey on 7 September.
The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.
The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.
The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.
Juliet discovers if the Octa is the ultimate Land Rover Defender. Nissan gives the X-Trail a new lease on life, and we find out what you can expect from Mazda in South Africa.
The "AWDC" is a british offorad event where drivers have to tackle tight and twisty roads filled with mud und gravel.

Sagie and Richard explore whether modern three-cylinder turbo engines are built to last, compare life after Audi ownership with a move to BMW, and explain when it's really time to replace a timing chain.
We take a trip to Mozambique for the annual Classic Car Rally and come across a hot rod that undoubtedly was every boy's dream back in the 1980s.
We visit the inaugural Cape Town Motor Show, Bots shows of their next contender for Burnout Kingz, and we go on an all women’s 4x4 adventure.

GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.
Since 1950, the exhilarating Morgan +4 has been the mainstay of Morgan production. The ARP4 is the latest addition to the +4 family and strictly limited to a run of 50.

Rally Coromandel sends the New Zealand Rally Championship onto spectacular coastal gravel roads, where speed, precision and consistency are vital. With the title fight heating up, every stage and every second matter in this tense mid-season showdown.
The "Le Mans Cup" is an european multiclass championship for LMP3 & GT-cars and also known as the second devision to the ELMS.
The European Le Mans Series is a multiclass endurance championship with several races across Europe.

Rally Bay of Plenty serves up intense New Zealand Rally Championship action, with the leading crews chasing points on demanding gravel stages. Expect high-speed drama, technical challenges and momentum swings as the season builds toward its climax.

GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.

The International Rally of Whangarei brings the 2025 New Zealand Rally Championship to a thrilling conclusion. On world-class gravel roads, the leading crews battle for rally victory and the chance to secure the top prize in a dramatic season finale.

The GT World Series Australia delivers high-octane GT3 racing Down Under. Professional drivers and top Amateurs battle wheel-to-wheel on some of Australia’s most challenging circuits in this fiercely competitive championship.

When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

High winds force a shortened course as drivers tackle the mountain. GT4 Trophy by Yokohama and Time Attack One classes push for top times in a demanding run where changing conditions and altitude make every second count.

The GT World Challenge Europe is back for another season. The schedule consists of 10 rounds at high-level circuits, split evenly between the Endurance Cup and Sprint Cup. And once again, the calendar features the Total 24 Hours of Spa as the marquee event.
Exhibition and Open Wheel classes tackle a shortened course due to high winds, featuring Honda’s hydrogen-powered CR-V debut and Fred Veach’s emotional farewell run on the mountain.

The Open Division tackles a shortened course due to high winds, featuring rookie runs, Lonni Unser’s charge, J.R. Hildebrand’s NASCAR stock car, a Michèle Mouton tribute, and Ford’s radical electric Mustang Mach-E.

All-Wheel drive is not just for off-road adventures. The new Mercedes E-Class T-Model sends its power to all four wheels to ensure abnormal acceleration and the best dynamic handling in bends. Paired with the output of 333 hp, the AMG version becomes a powerful estate wagon.

In Ron's Garage antique scrap piles from the desert get turned into rolling pieces of art in accordance with customer specifications. If you want to cross the desert, Mercedes has the perfect vehicle.
The Unlimited Division features exotic prototypes, rookie standouts, Robin Shute in a brutal Camaro, and a fierce Nova Proto showdown between Diego De Gasperi and Simone Faggioli.
The Stunt Heroes having fun on a hudge industrial Area. Here it comes to the showdown between man and machine - Stuntman against BMW 3.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

We took the Mercedes AMG SLS GT to an airfield and the Porsche 911 Turbo S to the racetrack in order to see these sporty driving machines in action and test their performance. In addition: the Audi R8 4.0 TFSI's innovative lighting technology.

Once a year the noblest and rarest classic cars are gathered at one location: the Concorso d' Eleganza Villa d'Este at Lake Como about 50 kilometers north of Arese. Proud owners present their vintage vehicles from long forgotten decades.

Jaguar found their way back to the world of sports cars. The F-Type doesn't just look good, it's got what it takes, and the car is able to take on the competition like the BMW Z4. We also took a closer look at two other competitors, the Porsche Boxster S and Nissan's 370 Z.
The Belcar Endurance Championship is the top-tier national endurance racing championship in Belgium. The series is sanctioned by the Royal Automobile Club of Belgium and run by Circuit Zolder.

For more than 60 years the Corvette has been the embodiment of the American sports car. Also: the Ford Mustang GT, an iconic model with a V8 engine at the price of a Volkswagen Passat. And: the Chevrolet Camaro, another classic from the land where cylinder capacity is still valued a lot.
1990 saw the launch of the inaugural season of the fastest brand trophy in the world: the Porsche Carrera Cup.
A lot of power thanks to a compressor. This optimized O.CT Lamborghini Huracán delivers over 800 horse power to get the blood flowing.
Since 1950, the exhilarating Morgan +4 has been the mainstay of Morgan production. The ARP4 is the latest addition to the +4 family and strictly limited to a run of 50.
A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

It's the fastest art collection in the world. Designed by famous artists like Andy Warhol, Roy Liechtenstein, Frank Stella or Jeef Koons, these racing artworks have been used by BMW in Le Mans for years.

The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

Vive la difference: Their design is always unusual, their comfort is always extraordinary, and their ideas are often avant-garde: Of course we’re talking about the cars from Renault. With the help of the Dauphine, Renault is contributing to the economic miracle.

Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.
The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as "The Race to the Clouds".
US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

The Autodromo Nazionale Monza is famed for its speeds. A track known for low-drag set-ups, full throttle racing, and the occasional slipstream battle, Monza is a true drivers’ circuit and home to some of the greatest races in motorsports history.

The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.
With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evo

'If you own a Jeep, we're everything that you'll need' - That's what the people at ORZ Vehicles pride themselves with. By selling and assembling accessories for Jeep, they make the American off-road dream come true for European customers.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.
Once a year the American Classic, Custom and Hot Rods meet at the Street Mag Show. Not in Michigan however, but on the A3 between Wuerzburg and Erlangen in Germany.

In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

A skidding lorry against a remote controlled family van. Thats the new story the Stunt Heroes realize on their private Autobahn. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanskis goal: to separate the roof from the rest of the car. If the plan works out, they will create a unique stunt convertible.

The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.
An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.
The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.
The G-Power M5 Hurricane RS Touring is one of the fastest station wagons in the world. Also: the Artega GT. And: the Austin FX4.
Monster Jam is an American monster truck series where drivers have to perform stunts and race against each other.

The company Mechatronik is dedicated to the restoration and refinement of Mercedes-Benz classics. Also: the Nissan 370 Z takes on Porsche Cayman & Co. And: the Chevrolet Camaro and the Mercedes-AMG ML 63.
The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds.

The MF5 GT, the powerhouse from Wiesmann. What's more: if you're looking for exclusivity and find even the performance of a Mercedes-AMG too low, you've come to the right place. The Brabus company is one of the most famous tuners in the world.

The International Motor Show in Geneva is the first important vehicle fair of the year. Of course, the top class refiners must not be missing. Also: the Mercedes-AMG SL 63. The sixth generation of the SL is more powerful than ever before.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.
The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles.
The tuning forge MTM is known for its extremely dynamic, optimally tuned vehicles. What's more: the Nissan Juke-R is a projectile with the dimensions of a cigar box and 485 hp of power.

The 2025 European Motocross Championship is the 37th European Motocross Championship season since it was revived in 1988. It includes 16 events and 6 different classes. It will start in Spain on 16 March and will end in Turkey on 7 September.

Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.
The Lancia Stratos with Ferrari power, the rally icon of the 1970s.
The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.
Spectacular drifts are to be expected when Ken Block visits the Gymkhana Grid.

Audi is one of the most successful car manufacturers of the present day. The brand with the four rings stands for innovation, superior technology and unique design. Founded over 100 years ago, Audi is now a successful global player.
The "AWDC" is a british offorad event where drivers have to tackle tight and twisty roads filled with mud und gravel.

In 1932, the economic crisis led to the merger of the Horch, DKW, Audi and Wanderer brands under the name Auto Union, the second largest German car manufacturer at the time, which made motor sport history with the famous Silver Arrow racing cars.
Cruising on the motorways is so boring. Then off-road you go! 4x4 shows how sporty and elegant SUVs really are, and which vehicles can make your day on exciting off-road tracks.

Henry Ford paved the way for the automotive revolution at the beginning of the 20th century. With the Ford Model T, the company conquered not only the USA but the whole world and made its inventor one of the richest men.

German Tuner SKN organizes the so-called Dyno Day, an event where speed-junkies can test how much power their cars really have. Tuning meets Freddy who takes the chance to put his Chevrolet Camaro on the dynamometer.
Few manufacturers have been as active in the USA and Europe as early as Ford - and with success. While the Mustang thrilled American youth, the Capri turned the heads of Europeans.

The Stunt Heroes have a new car-canon in their arsenal. The canon accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The Stunt Heroes had something like that before. But the new canon doesnt produce any smoke.

Porsche has competed in the 24-hour Le Mans classic every year since 1951. The company's prototypes have won 18 times - more often than the vehicles of any other manufacturer in the history of this racing series.
This show brings you the best mix of national and international powersports from around the world.

The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.
If a car arrives in a trailer, its value is usually very high. The original BMW 328 Schlüter is already rare and expensive. But this model is a reconstruction and it is absolutely unique.
The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

Smart offers its iconic city car with a convertible option. The Mini cabriolet is bigger and provides room for four people. When it comes to roadster feeling, the Mazda MX-5 is on top of the list. We took a closer look at these three open-top contenders.

The Paris Motor Show features the automotive world of tomorrow. In 2016 Mercedes-Benz introduced their “Generation EQ” and Volkswagen announced to build 20 new electrified models by 2020, possibly in order to distract from the emission scandal.
The "BRC" is a belgian rally championship where drivers of modern rally cars compete against each other on gravel and tarmac.

What would make coupe fans opt for a more traditional two-door model like the Mercedes-Benz E400 instead of its bigger brother, the CLS with four doors? Also: does the Volkswagen Arteon stand a chance against the Mercedes CLS?

A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ an
It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.
The 2026 Championship will be held over seven events, with five gravel rounds and two tarmac rounds, offering something for everyone.
The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.
In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.
